notes.title: The Random Flux Update
notes.content: [p]The chaos never stops in Ominoflux! 🎉[/p][p]The [b]Random Flux Update[/b] is here, mixing together tweaks, upgrades, and brand-new add-ons in true flux fashion. Here are the details:[/p][p][/p][p][b]✨ UI & Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved campaign mode HUD, transitions and readability[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaner icons and sharper pixel text[/p][/*][*][p]Added more details to world map[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]⚙️ Gameplay Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted game play balance[/p][/*][*][p]Added a secret ultra hard quest in campaign mode[/p][/*][*][p]Quality-of-life changes for smoother runs[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked dialogue to sharpen storytelling[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded in-game text and descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Polished up on the writing everywhere[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🆕 Add-ons & Extras[/b][/p][list][*][p]New secret level added[/p][/*][*][p]4 new levels, 3 new monster types[/p][/*][*][p]Other small surprises to keep things fresh[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🔧 General Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimized loading performance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor bugs & glitches[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This game will continue to evolve. Ominoflux is a passion project, and I’ll keep supporting and expanding it indefinitely. If you do pick it up, know that more updates and surprises are always on the way.[/p][p]Flux be with you![/p]

notes.title: Recent Updates
notes.content:
Recent Updates
[list]
[*] Added a new PVP Mode
[*] Overall difficulty balancing issues tweaked
[*] Added 10+ new music pieces
[*] Improved many particle FX overall
[*] New Game Mode+ after game completion
[*] Fixed boss animation bug
[*] Corrected many localization text
[*] Added in-game commentary
[*] Updated NPC character artwork
[*] Vastly improved all the tutorials
[*] Added more character text lines
[*] Added button input re-assign function
[*] Corrected some sound default volume
[*] Leaderboard mode bug fixes
[*] Improved the Skills UI
[*] Block pieces can no longer overlap now
[*] Minor performance enhancements
[*] Corrected relic UI and titles
[*] End boss is substantially harder now
[*] Lockpicking stages difficulty increased
[*] Invader stages difficulty increased
[*] Critical hits now show damage properly
[*] Enemy total HP UI is now shown
[*] Set game under Difficult tag on Steam
[*] Added Arena endless mode difficulty
[*] Improved support for Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters
[*] Updated game store artwork
[*] All cutscenes are now skippable
[*] Added a simple campaign intro
[*] Core game and fluxing mechanic is now very stable
[*] Changed hard drops to immediately hit
[*] Updated campaign mode to be slightly harder
[*] Added a Malaysian Manglish mode for my in-game rant
[*] Added some secret areas
[*] Slightly increased the cost of upgrades
[*] Improved overall game feel - punchier now
[*] Added subskills such as Double hit, Snipe hit, Pilfer etc
[*] Increased the costs of Bombs, and limited to 3
[*] Added Arena reward tiers
[*] Added simple mod capability for block skins
[*] Improved some stage backgrounds
[*] New monster type: Bentiks and Yahats
[*] Total revamp on how the combo system works
[*] Skills stocks up differently in Hi-Score mode
[*] Added credits scene upon game completion
[*] Many other minor bug fixes and improvements
[/list]
